question: When interactive and batch requests contend for one self-hosted inference server, does MoFlux preserve interactive service while still letting batch use otherwise-idle capacity?

locality.note: This benchmark has no spend guard because no upstream it is permitted to reach can bill. Every arm endpoint, the Ollama upstream, and the control plane are checked against the locality rule before the first request, and no flag disables the check.

armDescriptions.direct: requests go straight to Ollama; no admission control
armDescriptions.static: fixed per-class protected floors, never lent
armDescriptions.moflux: same floors, lent while idle and restored on demand

phases.name: warm-up
phases.note: 5 requests per class per arm, excluded from every distribution

lending.framing: Admission slots are Tyr-local and can be taken back from a borrower by an expiring deadline (enforced). Upstream token capacity cannot be reclaimed once in flight at the provider: an unlent slice is withheld before lending (allocation-enforced), and everything else is a wall-clock objective. Tyr reports upstream cancellation as unverified and this benchmark never restates it as reclaimed capacity.

mechanism.lend: deferred to the next grant issuance, which happens only after the current lease expires
mechanism.restore: accelerated acknowledged handoff; commits without waiting for the lease

leaseGap.note: Latchflo issues a replacement grant only after the previous lease has expired, so the pool briefly holds no grant and Tyr admits nothing. Both managed arms carry the same lease, so this is never a variable between them.

handoff.note: An aborted handoff is the control plane declining a reallocation whose preconditions lapsed. It is the safe outcome and is priced as slower restoration, not counted as unsafe.

lending.restorationLatencyNote: restorationLatencyMsMedian is the grant coming back. occupancyRestorationLatencyMsMedian is the protected class being able to use it. The two differ by however long the borrowers already in flight take to finish, because no arm here preempts an admitted upstream request.

demandReturn.timebase: Sampler offsets are milliseconds from the arm's measured start. Generator-side instants are shifted by loadgenSkewMs onto the same origin; when that skew is unknown they are reported as null rather than aligned by assumption.

diagnostics.note: Credentials are minted by demo/identity-fixture-lib.mjs and re-minted on access as they approach expiry. Fingerprints and expiries are recorded; bearer tokens never are.

enoughSeeds.reason: a single run is not evidence; the sweep must carry the seed count it claims

everySeedValidAndSafe.reason: validity and safety are absolute, not averaged: one unsafe seed fails the run

h1InteractivePreserved.reason: H1: under contention MoFlux must complete materially more interactive work within the predeclared TTFT and completion-latency SLOs than unmanaged Ollama

h2BatchBorrowedIdleCapacity.reason: H2: while the interactive floor is idle, MoFlux must complete materially more batch work than a rigid static partition

h3ProtectedFloorNeverViolated.reason: H3: the configured interactive protected floor is never violated

h4aNoUnsafeCapacityTransfer.reason: H4a: lending and restoration move capacity without creating it, without breaching a class ceiling, pool grant, floor sum or unlent slice, and without committing a handoff that was never acknowledged

h4bNoBorrowingAfterProtectedDemandReturn.reason: H4b: once protected demand returns, no new borrowing of that class's floor begins and every restoration-required episode converges

failed.reason: H1: under contention MoFlux must complete materially more interactive work within the predeclared TTFT and completion-latency SLOs than unmanaged Ollama

evidenceLimits.measuredLayer: Admission only. Every number here is a decision Tyr made about whether to let a request reach Ollama, plus what the caller then experienced.
evidenceLimits.gpuPreemption: not-claimed: nothing in this stack observes or controls a GPU.
evidenceLimits.gpuUtilization: not-measured: no GPU counter is read, so no utilization figure is reported.
evidenceLimits.kvCacheReclamation: not-claimed: Ollama's KV cache is neither observed nor addressed.
evidenceLimits.ollamaSchedulerPreemption: not-claimed: Ollama's internal scheduler is treated as an opaque FIFO with OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL slots. A shed request is one that never arrived, not one that was preempted.
evidenceLimits.upstreamReclamation: not-claimed: no arm here configures a borrowed-slot deadline, so no in-flight upstream request is ever cancelled. Restoration is by attrition plus withheld allocation.
evidenceLimits.decodeDeterminism: unverified: temperature is 0 and each attempt carries a trace-derived seed, but arms differ in retry count and therefore in attempt seeds, and the server's prefix cache state differs. Equal token totals would not evidence equal text and are not presented as doing so.
evidenceLimits.generalization: none: qwen3:0.6b on a CPU-only containerised Ollama. The concurrency scaling that makes this workload contended is a property of that configuration and does not transfer to a GPU-backed server or a larger model.
evidenceLimits.productionScale: none: single host, single model, single replica per arm, tens of requests per arm per seed.

sameTrace.threshold: one trace hash across every arm
sameTrace.reason: arms must replay one immutable trace or the comparison is between two workloads

everyArmRan.reason: a missing arm makes the comparison undefined rather than partial

warmupExcluded.reason: weight loading and estimator convergence must not enter a measured distribution

idleCapacityBeforeContention.threshold: interactive work before batch starts, and no batch work in that window
idleCapacityBeforeContention.reason: the idle window must actually be idle of batch, or there was no spare capacity to lend

batchAdmittedAndCompleted.reason: an arm that admitted no batch work cannot evidence useful borrowing

interactiveConstrainedUnderContention.threshold: contention-window tail above idle-window tail on the direct arm
interactiveConstrainedUnderContention.reason: without measurable queueing in the control arm there is no contention to protect against

classesResolved.threshold: Tyr classified each workload as its own admission class
classesResolved.reason: a run whose traffic all landed in one class measured no partition at all

leaseGapWithinBudget.reason: a short grant lease buys mid-run lending at the cost of a brief ungranted window per expiry; past this share the arm is measuring the reconcile loop, not the policy

staticArmLeftCapacityIdle.reason: rigid isolation must actually refuse batch work, or the static arm is not rigid

noUnlentFloorViolations.reason: the allocation-enforced slice of the interactive floor must never be lent

noClassCeilingViolations.reason: a class may never hold more in flight than its granted ceiling

noCeilingOverAllocation.reason: lending moves capacity between classes; it may not create any

noPoolOverAllocation.reason: total in-flight work may never exceed the pool grant

noFloorSumOverAllocation.reason: protected floors may never sum above the capacity they partition

noBorrowGrowthAfterDemandReturn.reason: borrowers already in flight when protected demand returned may drain, but the borrowing class must not take more of the protected class's nominal floor after that instant, and may not refill a slot a grandfathered borrower has given back

noUnsafeHandoff.reason: a capacity handoff must be acknowledged before it is committed; an aborted handoff is the safe outcome and is priced as slower restoration rather than gated here

everyLentFloorRestored.reason: when protected demand returns while capacity is lent, that capacity must come back; a lend whose owner never returned is a passive return, not a restoration failure

noDeadlineAbandonments.reason: no arm configures a borrowed-slot deadline, so an abandonment would mean the run and its configuration disagree about which pool was measured

noBorrowGrowthAfterRestoration.reason: borrowers already in flight when protected demand returned may drain, but the borrowing class must not take more of the protected class's nominal floor after that instant, and may not refill a slot a grandfathered borrower has given back
